task_description:
Clean up and reorganize contacts and categories as follows:

- Merge duplicate “Jenny Lee” records:
  - Keep the “Jenny Lee” contact that already has an email and address.
  - Add the phone number +1-555-893-7781 from the other “Jenny Lee” record to the kept contact’s phone_numbers.
  - Append “Yoga class partner.” to the kept contact’s existing notes (keep the existing note content as well).
  - Delete the “Jenny Lee” contact that has no email or address.

- Create a new category named “Sports Clubs” with description “Sports clubs and recreational organizations.”

- Resolve duplicate “Friends” categories:
  - Keep the “Friends” category whose description is “Personal friends and close acquaintances.”
  - For the other “Friends” category (the sports-oriented one), remove it from all contacts.
  - Ensure “Jenny Lee” remains assigned to the kept “Friends” category and does not have the sports-oriented “Friends” category.
  - Assign “Greenfield Tennis Club” to the new “Sports Clubs” category and remove any “Friends” categories from it.
  - After these reassignments, delete the sports-oriented “Friends” category.

- Add a new category named “Emergency” with description “Priority contacts to reach in urgent situations.” Assign this “Emergency” category to the kept “Jenny Lee” contact.
